messages:
samira: Heads-up: schema-sanity CI started failing on master after yesterday's RBAC role-wrapping change. Failing assertion in audit-validator: actor.id missing for system_role users.

samira: ```
{ "event_type": "policy.grant", "actor": { "role": "system_role", "id": null }, "resource": {"id":"res-123"}}
```

oliver: Ack, can you paste the exact failing payload and which test is erroring?

samira: It's audit-validator/unit::test_event_actor_present on linux-x86. Reproduces locally: 3/3. Golden diff shows actor.id removed in 8 fixtures.

maria: We changed RBAC to inline anon actors for system roles; audit pipeline assumed id present. Should we tolerate null or preserve an id? Customers expect actor.id for some audit types.

jon: CI flake vs regression? Any recent golden updates?

samira: Not from CI: the commit that changed RBAC mapping pushed yesterday. Failing files: tests/goldens/audit/role-grant-*.golden. Logs:

samira: ```
AssertionError: actor.id is required
  at audit_validator.validate_event (/app/audit/validator.py:82)
```

eng-bot: Build 6789: regressed tests: audit-validator/unit::test_event_actor_present (3 failures). flake_score=0.92

oliver: If we relax validator, we might mask auth regressions. Proposal: allow missing actor.id only when actor.role == "system_role" and add synthetic deterministic id in RBAC shim for persisted logs. Update goldens accordingly.

maria: Adding synthetic ids affects customer-facing logs. We need privacy review and make sure ids are non-reversible. Pinging @security-review for guidance.

security-review: synthetic ids acceptable if deterministic non-reversible (HMAC with internal key). Document change and include opt-out for customers; also rotate key policy.

samira: Repro steps for devs: checkout branch rbac/synthetic-actor, run `./scripts/validate_audit.py --goldens` and regenerate goldens in tests/goldens/audit. CI job name: audit-goldens-validate.

oliver: I'll open PR that updates validator logic + migration to regenerate goldens + changelog entry. Assigning to maria for privacy sign-off.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll review once PR is up. Please add an e2e smoke that toggles RBAC_SHIM=synthesize_actor so CI catches future toggles.

jon: Short-term unblock: can we add a CI soft-fail tag to these tests until PR merges?

samira: Yes, I'll add ci/soft-fail:audit-actor-id to unblock release, and follow up with PR. Thanks everyone.
